summary: ScoutMePlay embedded Stripe verification with REAL pk_test/sk_test keys now in /app/backend/.env. 6/8 backend tests pass + 1 skipped + 1 deliberately-failing bug repro. /api/config/stripe correctly returns embedded_available=true and the full pk_test_51Slanq... publishable key. Embedded prepay-upload for free user returns 200 + client_secret + session_id; status endpoint reports payment_status=unpaid/status=open; Stripe SDK can retrieve the session and confirms metadata={brand:ScoutMePlay, company:Mentalkids, source:scoutmeplay_website, kind:prepay_upload}, ui_mode=embedded, amount_total=100 cents, currency=usd. Legacy /payments/prepay-upload still produces a redirect URL. Admin /unlock test is skipped (no unpaid report). Frontend: free@elitescout.com logged in, /upload paywall visible, click upload-prepay-btn, embedded-checkout-modal mounted with 17 Stripe iframes including js.stripe.com/v3/embedded-checkout-inner — full card form, Link, Amazon Pay, ZIP all rendered as 'MENTALKIDS · SCOUTMEPLAY SECURE CHECKOUT · US$1.00'. Screenshot saved as embedded_modal_render.png. HOWEVER, two serious bugs were uncovered (see below).

critical.issue: emergentintegrations.StripeCheckout.__init__ globally mutates `stripe.api_base = https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe` whenever an `sk_test_emergent` key is used. Because the embedded endpoints share the same `stripe` Python module (imported as `stripe_sdk`), every embedded session created AFTER any legacy /payments/prepay-upload (or /payments/checkout) call in that backend worker is silently routed to the Emergent stub proxy instead of api.stripe.com — even though `stripe_sdk.api_key = STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` is reset. The returned `client_secret` then cannot be loaded by the real Stripe.js iframe on the frontend. Reproduced deterministically: after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, the first embedded session is on REAL Stripe and retrievable via SDK; immediately after one legacy /payments/prepay-upload call, the next embedded session is no longer on real Stripe (stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve returns `No such checkout.session`).

Sessions are created with `return_url` which puts Stripe.js into `redirect_on_completion: always` mode. After successful payment Stripe REDIRECTS to return_url and NEVER fires the `onComplete` handler in EmbeddedCheckoutModal.jsx. As a result `[data-testid=embedded-success-headline]` ('Payment confirmed') NEVER appears in the modal — the user is yanked to /upload?embedded_session=... and the modal closes. Stripe.js prints the warning '[Stripe.js] You passed an `onComplete` handler for a session that has `redirect_on_completion: always`. This `onComplete` handler will never be called.' Fix: pass `redirect_on_completion='never'` to stripe.checkout.Session.create (and stop sending return_url, OR keep it as fallback for the user to navigate after onComplete).

minor.issue: Webhook handler still only parses emergentintegrations-style events; real Stripe webhooks for embedded sessions are not processed. Crediting relies entirely on the frontend polling /api/payments/embedded/status — which works while user is on the page, but if they close the tab right after paying, the prepaid_uploads / report.is_paid flag may never get set. Add a /api/webhook/stripe-embedded route using stripe.Webhook.construct_event with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

integration_issues.issue: Because backend sets return_url, Stripe redirects after payment instead of calling onComplete. The 'Payment confirmed' success state inside EmbeddedCheckoutModal will never display. Eligibility is still credited (frontend polls /status on return), but the UX in-modal success path is broken.

action_items: CRITICAL: Stop emergentintegrations from polluting the global stripe.api_base seen by embedded endpoints. Easiest fix: at the top of every embedded endpoint, set `stripe_sdk.api_base = 'https://api.stripe.com'` (and `stripe_sdk.api_key = STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`) BEFORE any stripe_sdk call. Verify with the failing test `TestEmergentIntegrationsPollutesGlobalStripeBase::test_embedded_session_unusable_after_legacy_call`.

HIGH: In embedded endpoints (prepay-upload + unlock) pass `redirect_on_completion='never'` to stripe.checkout.Session.create so Stripe fires onComplete instead of redirecting. Either drop return_url entirely or keep it as a manual-navigate fallback.
MEDIUM: Add a Stripe-native webhook route that uses stripe.Webhook.construct_event so that prepaid_uploads / report.is_paid are credited even if user closes tab before /status polling sees 'paid'.

LOW: Re-run the failing test_embedded_with_real_keys.py tests after the fix; both `TestEmergentIntegrationsPollutesGlobalStripeBase::test_embedded_session_unusable_after_legacy_call` and `TestAdminPriceUpdateEmbeddedAmount::test_update_price_to_5_then_session_unit_amount_500` should then pass (the latter only fails because the legacy-prepay test runs before it and poisons the global).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~2050 lines — split into routers (payments_legacy, payments_embedded, admin, reports).

stripe_sdk is the global `stripe` module — sharing it with emergentintegrations is fragile. Long-term fix: create a dedicated `stripe.StripeClient(api_key=...)` instance (Stripe SDK v7+ supports per-instance state) for embedded endpoints so module-level mutations from emergentintegrations don't bleed across.

Frontend EmbeddedCheckoutModal relies on Stripe's onComplete callback — but backend sets return_url, which forces redirect mode. The two are mutually exclusive; pick one (recommend onComplete + no return_url for true in-page UX).
_embedded_ready() check is good but should also reject placeholder keys like 'pk_test_xxx' (carryover from iteration_2).

success_rate.backend: 75% (6/8 pass, 1 skip, 2 fail) — the 2 failures both root-cause to the same stripe.api_base pollution bug
success_rate.frontend: Embedded modal rendered correctly with full Stripe iframe; card payment flow was NOT executed end-to-end due to the redirect_on_completion issue making the in-modal success state unreachable.

test_credentials: admin@elitescout.com / Admin@2026!Elite, free@elitescout.com / Free@2026, premium@elitescout.com / Premium@2026 — all working.
seed_data_creation: Several Stripe checkout sessions were created in test mode (both real Stripe and the Emergent stub proxy) during testing — they auto-expire after 24h.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BACKEND MUST BE RESTARTED before any embedded test run, because the bug (emergentintegrations polluting stripe.api_base) is sticky within a worker's lifetime. Run order matters: tests that touch /payments/prepay-upload or /payments/checkout (legacy) MUST come AFTER all embedded tests, otherwise embedded tests will silently route to the stub proxy. The frontend embedded modal DOES render correctly when freshly created sessions hit real Stripe (verified). For full payment success-state testing post-fix, use Playwright frame_locator to drill into js.stripe.com iframe, fill 4242 4242 4242 4242, 12/30, 123, ZIP 12345, then expect either (a) redirect to /upload?embedded_session=... + /me/upload-eligibility.prepaid_uploads >= 1, OR (b) [data-testid=embedded-success-headline] in modal IF backend is switched to redirect_on_completion='never'. Note Stripe.js mounts 17+ nested iframes; use frame_locator on src*='embedded-checkout-inner' and walk into the inner card-element frame.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: /root/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/emergentintegrations/payments/stripe/checkout.py lines 105 + 108-109 mutate `stripe.api_key` and `stripe.api_base` at the MODULE level whenever StripeCheckout is instantiated with `sk_test_emergent`. The backend's embedded endpoints (server.py:1734, 1805, 1867) import `stripe as stripe_sdk` — i.e. the SAME module object. They re-set `stripe_sdk.api_key = STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` per call but never reset `stripe_sdk.api_base`, which remains pointed at https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe for the rest of the worker's lifetime once any legacy endpoint has been called. The Emergent stub proxy happily accepts the real sk_test_51Slanq... key and returns plausible-looking `cs_test_...` session ids + client_secrets, but those sessions don't exist on real Stripe, so the Stripe.js frontend iframe cannot mount them. REPRO: see TestEmergentIntegrationsPollutesGlobalStripeBase. MITIGATION (one-line fix in server.py): in each of the 3 embedded endpoints, add `stripe_sdk.api_base = 'https://api.stripe.com'` immediately after `stripe_sdk.api_key = STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`. Long-term fix: migrate to `stripe.StripeClient(api_key=...)` per-instance API to fully isolate from emergentintegrations.
